chapter.title: Normative references
chapter.para: The following documents are referred to in the text in such a way that some or all of their content constitutes requirements of this document. For dated references, only the edition cited applies. For undated references, the latest edition of the referenced document (including any amendments) applies.

ul.li: The Unicode Consortium. Unicode Standard Annex, UAX #15, Unicode Normalization Forms[online]. Edited by Ken Whistler. Revision 54; issued for Unicode 15.1.0. 2023-08-12. Available at https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr15/tr15-54.html

The Unicode Consortium. Unicode Standard Annex, UAX #31, Unicode Identifiers and Syntax[online]. Edited by Mark Davis and Robin Leroy. Revision 39; issued for Unicode 15.1.0. 2023-09-01. Available at https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr31/tr31-39.html
